name: Free Online PPT (PPTX) Compressor - ATools
description: Free online PowerPoint (PPTX) compressor: Intelligently compress embedded images & media in PPTX presentations with lossy & lossless options. Drastically shrink file size locally in your browser.
seoDescription: Free online PowerPoint (PPTX) presentation compressor with lossy and lossless options. Automatically discovers and optimizes large embedded images, illustrations, and background photos inside PowerPoint slides while preserving original animations, typography, and layout. Drastically reduces PPTX file size for easier sharing and email attachments. Runs 100% locally in your browser with zero file uploads.

ui.title: Smart PPT Slide Compressor
ui.dropHint: Drop .pptx file here or click to upload.
ui.modeBalancedDesc: Optimizes embedded illustrations, converts non-transparent PNGs to high-quality JPEG, and repacks ZIP with maximum compression. Balanced quality and size.
ui.modeAggressiveDesc: Stronger compression (720P / 55% quality), cleans thumbnails, shrinking size by 60%~90%. Ideal for email attachments and web sharing.
ui.modeLosslessDesc: Preserves 100% pixel-exact quality and resolution. Optimizes PNG Deflate, strips metadata, and repacks container with level 9 compression.
ui.modeRepackOnlyDesc: Repackages the ZIP container without modifying any embedded image resources.
ui.modeCustomDesc: Freely configure media compression mode (lossy/lossless), resolution limit, quality slider, and conversion rules.
ui.mediaVideoWarning: Detected embedded audio/video media (~{size}). This is usually the primary factor causing huge presentation files. Consider compressing video assets for further reduction.
ui.settingConvertPngDesc: Automatically converts non-transparent PNG illustrations to high-quality JPEG, drastically reducing file size
ui.settingStripThumbnailDesc: Removes cached preview thumbnail inside PPTX to save extra storage
ui.emptyHint: Click "Compress Presentation" to obtain the optimized PPT file
tips: Over 85% of a PowerPoint (.pptx) file size usually comes from embedded photos and background images;
This tool unpacks locally in your browser, resampling images or applying lossless Deflate optimization without altering slide animations or typography;
Offers both [Lossless Maximum] (100% pixel fidelity) and [Aggressive Lossy] compression modes to meet different needs from big-screen presentations to strict email limits;
All processing happens 100% client-side without uploading files to any server, keeping your data confidential.
ui.errNotPptx: Please upload a PowerPoint presentation ending in .pptx
ui.errFailed: Compression failed. Please ensure the file is a valid .pptx presentation.
